scripts.build:assets: node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/css/styles.css --minify --outfile=public/css/styles.min.css && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/css/admin.css --minify --outfile=public/css/admin.min.css && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/js/main.js --minify --outfile=public/js/main.min.js && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/js/booking.js --minify --outfile=public/js/booking.min.js && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/js/cuidados.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/js/cuidados.min.js && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/js/faq.js --bundle --minify --outfile=public/js/faq.min.js && node_modules/.bin/esbuild public/js/admin.js --minify --outfile=public/js/admin.min.js
scripts.dev: npm run build:assets && uv run pywrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:assets && uv run pywrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run build:assets && uv run pytest
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:assets && uv run pytest tests/unit
